snippet.title: Nautical Life : Boat Tycoon game - gameplay overview
snippet.description: Welcome aboard to the world of Nautical Life - a Boat Tycoon Game. Come sail your boat and enjoy a unique experience of an idle Fishing with RPG! Here you can buy your dream yacht or boat and customize the interior to all tastes. Watch the cycle of the day and the night affecting the landscape and the fishing.
